limitations: Notion does not permit apps to read any pages or databases until the end-user explicitly selects and shares them with the integration during OAuth authorization.
Internal integrations use an internal token without OAuth; public distribution requires completing Notion's integration distribution form.

assumptions: Developer has Notion account and workspace
Using standard Notion OAuth 2.0 flow for public integrations

externalWait.publishedRange: Instant activation for self-hosted OAuth integrations

prerequisites.text: Notion account with at least one active workspace

steps.title: Create Integration in Notion Developer Portal
steps.instructions: Navigate to notion.so/my-integrations. Click 'New integration'. Name your integration, associate it with an associated workspace, and select type: 'Public' (for multi-workspace OAuth) or 'Internal'.
steps.completionCheck: Integration created with OAuth credentials visible.

steps.title: Configure Redirect URIs and Public Settings
steps.instructions: In the 'Distribution' tab, toggle on 'Make integration public'. Fill in Company or Developer name, Website URL, Privacy Policy URL, and Redirect URIs (e.g. `https://app.example.com/api/auth/callback/notion`). Click 'Submit'.
steps.completionCheck: Client ID and Client Secret are displayed.

steps.title: Build Authorization URL with Required Parameters
steps.instructions: Construct the authorization URL: `https://api.notion.com/v1/oauth/authorize?client_id={CLIENT_ID}&response_type=code&owner=user&redirect_uri={ENCODED_REDIRECT_URI}`. Redirect the user to this link.
steps.completionCheck: Notion permission consent screen displays to users.

steps.title: Exchange Authorization Code via HTTP POST
steps.instructions: When Notion redirects back to your callback URL with `?code=...`, send an HTTP POST to `https://api.notion.com/v1/oauth/token` using Basic Auth header with base64(`client_id:client_secret`). Include body `{'grant_type': 'authorization_code', 'code': '...', 'redirect_uri': '...'}`.

blockers.title: No Workspace Pages Visible By Default
blockers.description: After successful OAuth connection, API calls may return empty results unless the user explicitly chose 'Select pages' in Notion's authorization prompt.

claims.text: Public integrations require completing developer website and privacy policy fields in the developer portal.
Redirect URIs must use HTTPS, except for http://localhost.
Notion OAuth requires Basic HTTP Authorization header encoded with client_id:client_secret during code exchange.
Notion access tokens do not currently expire and do not require refresh tokens for public integrations.

selectedPassages: Public integrations use OAuth 2.0 to request access to Notion workspaces from users.
Users choose which pages to grant access to during the authorization flow.
